thread:
sasha_cs: Hi team — launching Starlark onboarding thread. Quick framing: sprint-0 (10 days) goals are: wire Redwood Hosted into their support flow, run a 10-sample latency+quality benchmark, and train their CSMs on Console. @eli_pm and @marta_sre joined the kickoff call earlier. Who'll take owners?

eli_pm: I'll own PM liaison + coordinate their engs. Prefer Wed 9am PT weekly sync. I'll share the contact for their infra lead (Marta has it) and ask for 10 anonymized tickets by EOD tomorrow.

marta_sre: Marta (Starlark SRE) here. We require signed webhooks and IP allowlist; also need EU region confirmation for some data paths. I'll open an internal ticket for peering/allowlist — ETA 48h. If direct peering delayed, we accept a secure proxy.

dylan_se: I can handle integration pairing and model selection. Need staging API keys + sample payloads. I'll post a smoke-test curl and a tiny Node snippet for their engineers.

ravi_success: I'll draft acceptance criteria: (1) E2E ticket flow validated in staging, (2) CSMs complete the Console checklist, (3) 95th percentile latency target <350ms on the 10-sample set. Callout: flag renewal risk if go-live slips past Day 28.

sasha_cs: Action items: 1) eli to intro Starlark infra + SRE by EOD; 2) Starlark to provide staging keys + 10 anon tickets by Day 2; 3) dylan to share smoke tests Day 1-2; 4) ravi to post acceptance tests Day 2; 5) I'll spin up a sprint board and assign owners today. Please surface any legal/compliance gating now.

marta_sre: Intro done. Also sharing compliance contacts. Compliance asked whether Hosted can guarantee EU-region routing — would be great to confirm routing and fallback options.

dylan_se: Quick curl smoke-test for their engineers (sanity check):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"input":"Summarize ticket: <body>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

eli_pm: I'll export 10 anonymized tickets and drop them in the shared folder by tomorrow EOD. Also scheduling first sync Wed 9am PT — invite incoming.

ravi_success: I'll validate EU routing + fallback policies by tomorrow and post cost/dedicated delta if Private is required. If Dedicated becomes necessary, I'll add that as a separate decision point in the board.

onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist: /docs/onboarding/starlark-template — includes Console runbook, API quickstart, security questionnaire, and evaluation prompt set.

sasha_cs: Quick ask: after the first 48h ask their CSMs to attempt the Console runbook and capture any confusing steps so we can iterate. We'll meet Wed 9am PT and review blockers. :thumbsup:

eli_pm: Sounds good — excited to get rolling.

(onboarding thread ended)
